name: Release Video Engine
tagline: A reproducible release-to-video pipeline that transforms validated GitHub release content and product media into branded vertical, square and landscape MP4s.
problem: Small software teams ship updates through CI but still repeat manual release communication tasks: selecting highlights, building timelines, preparing screenshots and adapting videos for multiple platform aspect ratios.
scenario: A public GitHub release or tag is normalized, paired with approved product branding and screenshots, and rendered through a template registry into 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9 compositions with measurable render outputs.
differentiation: Validated release metadata, a format-independent typed composition contract and deterministic Remotion templates preserve editorial control rather than relying on unpredictable text-to-video claims.
architecture: Public GitHub release/tag -> validated normalized release payload -> brand and media spec -> Remotion compositions -> reproducible MP4 files for vertical, square and landscape publishing.
limitations: A render prototype is not a live scheduling or publishing platform. Aspect-ratio outputs are testable artifacts, but actual prospect demand, export production quality, costs and paid pilots must be independently validated.

capabilities.name: Release source normalization
capabilities.description: Read and distinguish published public GitHub releases from tag fallback in a typed adapter.

capabilities.name: Multi-format composition
capabilities.description: Define branded Remotion release-video specs and aspect-ratio presets.

capabilities.name: AgenFetch proof render
capabilities.description: Render the documented sample in three formats with an explicit command.

capabilities.name: Commercial self-service platform
capabilities.description: Validate demand and paid pilots before adding billing or distribution automation.

roadmap.name: Reproducible demo
roadmap.exitCriteria: Render one inspected public release in all three formats and review frame-safe readability.

roadmap.name: Evidence-based pricing
roadmap.exitCriteria: Measure render time/cost and validate buyer demand via defined prospect interviews.

roadmap.name: Concierge pilot
roadmap.exitCriteria: Demonstrate a branded video delivery accepted by a real product team before SaaS expansion.
